name: Duck

unlock.how: debug like a rubber duck: bashou learn <command>, bash -x or echo $?

tips: Stuck? Explain your script to me, line by line. It often fixes itself.
bash -x script.sh : every command, printed as it runs.
echo $? : 0 means the last command worked.
`bashou learn` takes a command apart, piece by piece.
personal: Explain it to me. Out loud. I'll wait.
